records.verificationNote: Read directly from Highmark Comprehensive Formulary drug-search pages for the HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin) class and the statin/ezetimibe combination rows. Generic atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, simvastatin, pravastatin, lovastatin are Tier 1 with a quantity limit, no PA. Brand Lipitor, Crestor, Zocor, Livalo, Zypitamag, Altoprev, Vytorin, Roszet, and generic ezetimibe-rosuvastatin are PA-flagged. Generic pitavastatin and fluvastatin are Tier 3 with quantity limit, no PA. Strength and sig are a representative 40 mg dose at standard label dosing. [Sonnet check 2026-10-21: Highmark legend (re-read on the live site) defines Tier 3 as "Non-Formulary Drug" that closed-formulary members do not get, so "covered, higher cost share" was overstated and Tier 3 alternatives now carry that caveat. Spot-checked on the live site: Aimovig 140 mg/mL is Tier 2 + QL + PA; Concerta 18 mg is Tier 3 + QL, no PA; both match.]

Repatha (Sureclick, Syringe, Pushtronex) is Tier 2 with PA, quantity limit and day-supply limit; Praluent is Tier 3 with PA. Leqvio (inclisiran) and Vyepti do not appear in these PCSK9 pages and are not recorded as covered or excluded. Full criteria text was not read beyond that revision note. Brand is the preferred agent; no generic exists.
